title: Color Mixer
description: Blend any two colors with a ratio slider — see the real mixed result as HEX and RGB with a live preview.
howto: Pick the two colors to mix.
Drag the ratio slider to control how much of each color is used.
Copy the resulting HEX or RGB value.

faqs.a: Linear interpolation in RGB space: each channel is mixed as a×ratio + b×(1−ratio), then rounded to the nearest integer.

faqs.q: Is this the same as mixing paint?
faqs.a: No — this is light-based (screen) mixing in RGB space, not subtractive pigment mixing. For print-like results, a CMYK model would be needed.
An exact halfway blend of both colors — equal parts color A and color B.
